description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different language models (LLMs) across two categories: Songs and Basketball. The vertical axis represents popularity, measured on a linear scale from 0 to 220. The horizontal axis lists the two categories. Each bar is color-coded to represent a specific LLM, with the following color assignments: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), ChatGPT (yellow), and two sets of bars with different patterns represent Acc=0 & GT Ans (dotted) and Acc=1 & GT Ans (solid). The bars are not sorted in any specific order. The tallest bars in the Songs category are for Llama3 and Qwen2, while in the Basketball category, the tallest bars are for ChatGPT and the patterned set representing Acc=1 & GT Ans. The shortest bars are for ChatGPT in the Songs category and for Llama3 in the Basketball category. The chart does not provide any annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
